summary.text: One of five centaurs Caeneus slew at Peirithous' wedding before the Lapith was buried under the pines.

story.text: Ovid's Nestor, telling of the centauromachy, names five centaurs put to death by Caeneus: Styphelus, Bromus, Antimachus, Elymus, and Pyracmos with his axe — their wounds forgotten, but their names and number recorded.
